decisions: Specialty label: 'Digital Health', reused from Digital Health Rewired 151 (rewired.json).

Call for proposals: the site has only /call-for-posters/ (not in the nav, found via page-sitemap.xml, robots allows). Mapped to the abstract fields as a poster call: abstract_deadline = its stated closing date 2026-10-11, abstract_open = False (closed). Notification date (31 Dec 2026) not stored.

Fee source: /register/ (Elementor raven-price-list cards). The displayed price is the early-bird rate; 'Advance Pricing goes into effect December 21, 2026' gives early_bird_deadline 2026-12-20 (day before). Each row yields an Early bird tier plus an Advance tier (from 21 December 2026).
Skipped on purpose: Market Suppliers rows (vendor company staff, same rule as ESGE Industry rows) and the free Press Pass. Government, HIMSS Member, Non-Member and Student are kept.

Venue: home header names 'McCormick Place Convention Center'; the venue page says 'McCormick Place'. The longer home-header name is stored. City/state come from the header's third segment via a hook because the family stops after the venue segment.
Description: the plain meta description (HIMSS27, Chicago); og:description is stale (HIMSS26, Las Vegas, March 2026) so it is never used.
Venue page is fetched only when the date line has no venue; here it is not needed (VENUE_URLS kept as fallback).
concerns: Lead expectation of Las Vegas / Venetian is the stale HIMSS26 og:description; the site states Chicago, McCormick Place for HIMSS27 (5-8 April 2027).
call-for-posters returned 403 to httpx once (second harness run); the production fetch path fell back to Playwright and succeeded. Intermittent, not a robots issue.
After 21 December 2026 the page will probably switch to the advance prices only; the parser then sees no 'goes into effect' sentence and emits Standard tiers (still correct).
After the congress ends the family sets verified_empty; the call-for-posters page will be gone/closed by then.
Informa blog pages mention 'save up to $700' (register-early blog); not parsed, no price table there.
Society code HIMSS must exist in medconf-website/src/lib/taxonomy/societies.ts (foreman owns registration).
Request count to himssconference.com about 30 including both harness runs; nothing fetched from himss.org.
